senses.example: Me he comprado unas zapatillas nuevas.
senses.exampleGloss: I have bought myself some new trainers.

senses.example: Me pongo las zapatillas en casa.
senses.exampleGloss: I put my slippers on at home.
senses.notes: Same word, two real Peninsular senses resolved by context (fuera de casa vs en casa).

alternatives.reason: Very common Peninsular synonym for sports shoes; both are natural.
LatAm form for trainers; in Spain tenis is the sport.

notes: Two senses are both standard Peninsular; the pair matters because zapatillas alone is ambiguous. Plural-only noun.
